name: nimiqearn-quest
description: Telegram-native task and bounty marketplace for the Nimiq ecosystem

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm run --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.dev:all: pnpm build:packages && pnpm run --parallel dev:api dev:web dev:bot
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @nimiqearn/api --filter @nimiqearn/bot --filter @nimiqearn/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck
